topic.instructions: Which topic best describes the sentence in `text`? The sentence may be written in any language or script; judge its meaning.

criteria.science/technology: Science and technology: research, discoveries, computing, space, the natural sciences
criteria.travel: Travel and tourism: trips, visiting places, getting around, advice for travellers
criteria.politics: Politics and government: elections, leaders, laws, policy, international relations, conflict
criteria.sports: Sports: games, athletes, teams, competitions and results
criteria.health: Health and medicine: illness, the body, treatment, nutrition, wellbeing
criteria.entertainment: Entertainment and culture: music, film, television, the arts, festivals, celebrities
criteria.geography: Geography: places, landforms, climate, oceans, countries and their physical features

intent.instructions: Which intent best matches the request in `text`? It is a request spoken to a voice assistant (a wake word such as 'olly' may appear) and may be written in any language or script; judge its meaning.

criteria.alarm_query: Ask about existing alarms: list or check alarms
criteria.alarm_set: Set a new alarm or wake-up time
criteria.audio_volume_down: Make the device quieter or lower the volume
criteria.audio_volume_mute: Mute, silence or pause the device's sound
criteria.audio_volume_other: Change the volume or audio settings in some other way
criteria.audio_volume_up: Make the device louder or raise the volume
criteria.calendar_query: Ask about calendar events, meetings or the schedule
criteria.calendar_remove: Delete or cancel a calendar event or meeting
criteria.calendar_set: Add a calendar event, meeting or reminder
criteria.cooking_query: Cooking questions: what to cook, substitutions, meal ideas
criteria.cooking_recipe: Ask for a recipe, its ingredients or how to cook something
criteria.datetime_convert: Convert a time between time zones or ask a time difference
criteria.datetime_query: Ask the current time or date, possibly in a place
criteria.email_addcontact: Add a new contact or email address to contacts
criteria.email_query: Check, read or ask about emails or messages received
criteria.email_querycontact: Ask for a contact's details (number, email) or call a contact
criteria.email_sendemail: Send, write or reply to an email or message
criteria.general_greet: A greeting or small talk, such as hello or how are you
criteria.general_joke: Ask for a joke or to be made to laugh
criteria.general_quirky: Other odd or open-ended requests that fit no other intent
criteria.iot_cleaning: Start the vacuum or cleaning robot
criteria.iot_coffee: Make coffee with the coffee machine
criteria.iot_hue_lightchange: Change the lights' colour, warmth or setting
criteria.iot_wemo_off: Turn off a smart plug or socket
criteria.iot_wemo_on: Turn on a smart plug or socket
criteria.lists_createoradd: Create a list or add an item to a list
criteria.lists_query: Ask what is on a list or about lists
criteria.lists_remove: Remove items from a list or delete a list
criteria.music_dislikeness: Say you dislike the current song or music
criteria.music_likeness: Say you like a song, artist or kind of music
criteria.music_query: Ask what song, artist or album is playing
criteria.music_settings: Change music playback settings such as shuffle, repeat or save
criteria.play_music: Play a song, artist or music
criteria.qa_definition: Ask for the meaning or definition of something
criteria.qa_stock: Ask about stock prices or the stock market
criteria.recommendation_events: Ask for recommended local events or things happening
criteria.recommendation_locations: Ask for recommended places such as restaurants, shops or venues
criteria.social_post: Post or send something on social media
criteria.social_query: Ask about social media updates or activity
criteria.takeaway_order: Order food for delivery or takeaway
criteria.takeaway_query: Ask about takeaway or delivery options, or an order's status
criteria.transport_query: Ask about directions, routes or travel information
criteria.transport_ticket: Book or find tickets for trains, flights or buses
